mapper.select: INSERT INTO media_generation_items (id, generation_job_id, media_plan_id, visual_beat_id, item_key, attempt_number, execution_status, provider_operation_id, media_asset_id, request_fingerprint, error_code, error_detail_ref, review_status, reviewed_by_user_id, reviewed_at) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{generationJobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{mediaPlanId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{visualBeatId}, #{itemKey}, #{attemptNumber}, #{executionStatus}, #{providerOperationId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{mediaAssetId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{errorCode}, #{errorDetailRef}, #{reviewStatus}, #{reviewedByUserId}, #{reviewedAt}) RETURNING id

SELECT i.* FROM media_generation_items i JOIN generation_jobs j ON j.id = i.generation_job_id JOIN projects p ON p.id = j.project_id WHERE i.id = #{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND p.owner_id = #{userId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL

SELECT i.* FROM media_generation_items i JOIN generation_jobs j ON j.id = i.generation_job_id JOIN projects p ON p.id = j.project_id WHERE i.generation_job_id = #{jobId,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND p.owner_id = #{userId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.item_key, i.attempt_number
mapper.update: UPDATE media_generation_items i SET review_status = #{decision}, reviewed_by_user_id = #{reviewerId}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM generation_jobs j JOIN projects p ON p.id = j.project_id WHERE i.id = #{id,typeHandler=com.narrativex.backend.feature.generation.infrastructure.persistence.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} AND i.generation_job_id = j.id AND p.owner_id = #{userId} AND p.archived_at IS NULL AND i.row_version = #{rowVersion} AND i.execution_status = 'READY' AND i.review_status = 'NEEDS_REVIEW'
